title: Child Password Request
scenario: A gaming friend asks your child for a login to boost their rank.

answers.A: Pay or share the requested details immediately to avoid trouble.
answers.B: Check through the official provider or saved family contact.
answers.C: Ask the caller or sender for more details before deciding.
answers.D: Stop, save evidence, and discuss with a trusted family member.

explanation: Child Password Request: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to confirm through a trusted person outside the message, not to send money or pay under pressure.
